REQUIRED ATTRIBUTION
CC BY 4.0 permits the licensor to specify the name and URI to be retained.
Reproduce the following, or a link-preserving equivalent:

    WattPair Appliance Load & Surge Provenance Dataset
© WattPair — CC BY 4.0
Source: https://wattpair.com/data/appliance-load/

WHAT IS COVERED
The compilation published by WattPair: the selection of figures, the
per-field provenance (source URL, source tier and type, verification date,
confidence, status and test conditions), the explicit nulls, the surge-basis
labelling, and the structure of the files at:
    /data/appliance-load/wattpair-appliance-load.json
    /data/appliance-load/wattpair-appliance-load.csv

WHAT IS NOT COVERED
The underlying source documents — manufacturer specification sheets, manuals,
government efficiency filings and standards documents — remain the property of
their respective publishers and are not sub-licensed here. Each figure names the
document it came from so it can be verified at the source. Individual
measurements are facts and are not subject to copyright. Short verbatim
quotations that appear inside test_conditions are quoted from those documents
under their own terms; they are not offered under CC BY 4.0.

NO WARRANTY
Published as-is. Figures are compiled from published documents and are not
independent laboratory measurements by WattPair. The dataset is deliberately
incomplete and records where: fields with no published figure are present and
null rather than estimated. Verify against the cited source before relying on
any figure for electrical sizing or safety decisions.
